 Associate has to work in multiole POCs using BI's cluster on various Big Data technologies. Work requires configuration, testing with various use cases and providing the findings in the areas of Catalog Management, Streaming, Data Visualizations ETL for Client Cards business.  

 POC's and development will involve Cognos, Tableau, Platfora, Qlikview and Datameer tools 

 Associate will be in a position to design Big data solutions for business needs and so should have a very good hands on experience on all the Big Data technologies
